approach_outcome.approach_summary: Successfully created a comprehensive __init__.py file that exports all view functions from the views_new package. Organized imports by module domain with clear comments and maintained a complete __all__ list for public API definition.

recommendations.recommendation: Add type hints to __all__ or consider using a package-level __init__ generator to reduce manual maintenance of the exports list
Add tests to verify all functions in __all__ are actually importable from the package root
Update module docstring with overview of view categories and their purposes for developers unfamiliar with the structure
Monitor export count; if it exceeds 25-30 functions, consider splitting into sub-packages (e.g., views_new.purchase, views_new.receiving)
